## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-fascicle Liú-Sòng translation of the *parinirvāṇa* of Mahāprajāpatī, parallel to [T148](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0148). The text is conventionally placed at the same date as Huìjiǎn's other 457 productions.

**Abstract**

T149 was produced by Huìjiǎn at the Lùyěsì in 457 CE (cf. [KR6a0043](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6a/KR6a0043)); the date is recorded in the frontmatter. The Indic source is presumed lost.
